description: Source code for OCIContainerImplementation class, managing OCI container lifecycle, notifications, and events within WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: OCIContainerImplementation
classes.description: Implements container management, event dispatching, and notification handling for OCI containers.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for container events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches container events asynchronously.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Handles event notification to registered observers based on event type and parameters.

methods.name: ListContainers
methods.description: Lists all containers via DobbyInterface.

methods.name: GetContainerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific container.

methods.name: GetContainerState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a container.

methods.name: StartContainer
methods.description: Starts a container with specified parameters.

methods.name: StartContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby specification.

methods.name: StopContainer
methods.description: Stops a container, optionally forcefully.

methods.name: PauseContainer
methods.description: Pauses a running container.

methods.name: ResumeContainer
methods.description: Resumes a paused container.

methods.name: HibernateContainer
methods.description: Hibernates a container with options.

methods.name: WakeupContainer
methods.description: Wakes up a hibernated container.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Adds an annotation key-value pair to a container.

methods.name: RemoveAnnotation
methods.description: Removes an annotation from a container.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mounts a filesystem source to a container.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a filesystem target from a container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container starts.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container fails.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked when container state changes.
